method.statistic: median of retained batch elapsed_ns / iterations
method.clock: kernel monotonic Generic Timer; elapsed wall time includes scheduling and waiting
method.timed_overhead: probe loop, workload string selection, return-value checks; no empty-loop subtraction
method.untimed: serial output, batch topinfo snapshots, setup, batch data comparisons and teardown
method.switches: system-wide batch context-switch delta, not task-exclusive
limitations: two full runs in one boot, not cold-boot repetitions
file workloads use RAM files, not SD
file service native protocol not measured

scope: First optimization pass: BSP reschedule IPI, event-driven process wait, compatibility PID cache, aligned kernel memory operations

diagnosis.root_cause: ARM64 BSP boot never enables reschedule IPI 0 after controller initialization clears the BCM2836 local mailbox mask. AP boot enables it.
diagnosis.qualification: The live register correction used an instrumented diagnostic kernel. Permanent source changes are measured separately.
diagnosis.diagnostic_failure: A separate instrumented run ended in a shell SIGSEGV after sample output and is not counted as passed.

host_pytest.command: uv run --frozen pytest -q scripts/tests/test_rpi.py scripts/tests/test_rpi_perf.py scripts/tests/test_production_boot.py scripts/tests/test_kernel_validation.py

verification.qemu_recheck_context: Identical kernel and validation initramfs; case watchdog increased from 5 to 30 host seconds. No code or internal one-second IPC deadline changes. The first attempt saw IPC handoff deadline failure and libc case timeout while host load averaged about 82; the libc snapshot was actively zeroing a demand-fault page. Rerun passed all 22 IPC and both libc cases; host contention is supported, not a proof that the first failure is impossible on the guest.

negative_control.source: BSP reschedule IPI enable omitted; no other changes

format_and_lint.third_party: lint.toml excludes third_party/** to preserve adaptation style. Direct upstream-style formatting of mlibc sysdeps.cpp also reports violations on HEAD; the existing local style was preserved.

limitations: Batch mean wall-clock medians, not individual latency percentiles or exclusive CPU time.
No PMU, CPU-frequency, temperature or sustained-power measurements.

An intermediate build showed same-core IPC +14% and fork+exec+wait +8-10%. Final clean runs did not reproduce those magnitudes, but raw fork+wait remains about +1-2.5% versus the two baseline medians. No single-change attribution or long-term noise model was established.
The original shared build directory was affected by concurrent monitor-related edits; final verification uses an isolated checkout.
Functional validation and hardware data exclude the concurrent monitor/top changes in the shared worktree.
failed_measurement_context: The rejected attempt lost the beginning of the first exec warmup line in its UART log. The host rejected the incomplete nine-row protocol despite zero guest exit status; no partial workload is counted as a full successful run. Its accepted earlier workloads remain in the failed report for inspection.
